title: The Basin and the Towel
reflectionQuestion: When was the last time someone served you in a way that caught you off guard?
reflectionText: It was the last night. Instead of giving a speech or issuing commands, he picked up a towel and a basin and got on his knees. Peter resisted because it felt wrong — the teacher serving the student. What is it to be served by someone you look up to, in a way that says this is not about position, this is about presence, this is what love looks like when it has nothing left to prove?

scriptureKeyVerse.text: For I have given you an example, that you should also do as I have done to you.
